metadata.description: XdrLogRaider — Sentinel content (parsers, workbooks, analytic rules, hunting queries).

tags.name: description
tags.value: Defender XDR drift events outside 09:00-17:00 UTC or on weekends. Daily SOC after-hours review pack — attackers prefer off-hours stealth changes. See KQL body for triage path + MITRE.

tags.name: description
tags.value: Correlates Defender XDR drift events with AuditLogs to attribute each config change to the admin UPN who triggered it. Drift parsers tell you WHAT changed; this query tells you WHO. See KQL body for triage path + baseline + MITRE.

tags.name: description
tags.value: Returns full current KQL text + schedule + enabled-state of every Defender XDR custom detection. Governance/review artifact — compliance audits + detection-content drift detection. See KQL body for triage path + MITRE.

tags.name: description
tags.value: Returns every file/path/process exclusion ADDED to AV/EDR policy across last 90 days. Exclusions are #1 EDR-bypass technique with admin compromise — every addition needs business justification + change ticket. See KQL body for triage path + MITRE.

properties.displayName: MDE Live Response sessions without justification

tags.name: description
tags.value: Defender Live Response sessions in last 7d with NO paired investigationId — direct shell without incident linkage. LR = SYSTEM access; every session needs justification. See KQL body for triage path + MITRE.

properties.displayName: MDE machine inventory by risk score

tags.name: description
tags.value: Latest snapshot of every device in MDE_Machines_CL inventory sorted by RiskScore desc. Daily SOC drill-down by risk priority — combines active alerts + TVM exposure into single triage view. See KQL body for triage path + MITRE.

tags.name: description
tags.value: Changes to Microsoft Defender for Identity directory service account classifications over last 30d — role escalations, service-account-to-user reclassifications, gMSA tagging changes. License-gated by MDI. See KQL body for triage path + MITRE.

tags.name: description
tags.value: Defender XDR Unified RBAC role assignments ADDED in last 30d, joined with current role state. Canonical privilege-escalation signal — every promotion needs ticket + owner. See KQL body for triage path + MITRE.

properties.displayName: MDE security policies (ASR + AV + EDR + Firewall) per platform

tags.name: description
tags.value: Latest snapshot of every Intune endpoint security policy across 4 platforms (Windows/Linux/macOS/iOS) — ASR rules, AV, EDR, Firewall, Disk Encryption, Account Protection, Web Protection. See KQL body for triage path + MITRE.

tags.name: description
tags.value: Composite attacker-preparation signal — counts days where BOTH a new suppression rule added AND PUA protection disabled. Either alone is normal admin; combo on same day is highly suspicious. See KQL body for triage path + MITRE.

properties.displayName: MDE TVM top vulnerable machines + inventory + remediation actions

tags.name: description
tags.value: Cross-stream TVM hunt — unions latest snapshots of top-vulnerable machines + active CVE inventory + software inventory + remediation tasks. Single operator view of entire TVM landscape. Requires TvmPremium. See KQL body for triage path + MITRE.

tags.name: description
tags.value: Nodes (machines, identities, groups, devices) NEWLY classified as XSPM chokepoints over last 30d. Chokepoints sit on many attack paths to crown jewels — eliminating one disrupts multiple scenarios. Requires XSPM. See KQL body for triage path + MITRE.

{"version":"Notebook/1.0","items":[{"type":1,"content":{"json":"# MDE Compliance Dashboard

**What this dashboard shows:** Current state of Defender XDR tenant security configuration with recent drift highlighted. Maps tenant config to compliance baselines (CIS, NIST, ISO27001) and surfaces deviations.

**Use cases:**
- **Quarterly compliance review**: SOC2/ISO27001 evidence pack + auditor-friendly views
- **CISO scorecard**: green/red posture indicators per category (RBAC, AV, ASR, EDR, Firewall)
- **Tenant onboarding**: validate baseline compliance before go-live
- **Drift accountability**: highlight what changed in last 24h/7d/30d for each category

**Data sources:** All Configuration tier streams (`MDE_AlertTuning_CL`, `MDE_SuppressionRules_CL`, `MDE_TenantAllowBlock_CL`, `MDE_UnifiedRbacRoles_CL`, `MDE_AdvancedFeatures_CL`, etc.) + drift parser overlays.

**Cadence:** 6h Configuration tier polls + recent-drift overlay from `MDE_Drift_Configuration`."},"name":"header"},{"type":9,"content":{"version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","parameters":[{"id":"timerange-param","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","name":"TimeRange","type":4,"value":{"durationMs":604800000},"typeSettings":{"selectableValues":[{"durationMs":3600000},{"durationMs":86400000},{"durationMs":604800000},{"durationMs":2592000000}]}}],"style":"pills","queryType":0},"name":"parameters"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"XdrConnectorHealth_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Tier in ('ActionCenter','XspmGraph','Configuration','Inventory','Maintenance')
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Streams = max(StreamsSucceeded) by Tier
| extend Status = iff(LastSeen > ago(30m), 'Healthy', 'Stale')","size":0,"title":"Connector health (last hour)","queryType":0,"visualization":"table"},"name":"health-panel"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"MDE_Drift_Inventory(7d, 1h)
| summarize Changes = count() by StreamName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart","size":0,"title":"P0 drift events","queryType":0},"name":"drift-timechart"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"Defender_EndpointConfiguration_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_LiveResponseConfig_CL'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FeatureName
| project FeatureName, IsEnabled, TimeGenerated
| order by FeatureName asc","size":0,"title":"Live Response config","queryType":0,"visualization":"table"},"name":"lr-table"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"let drift = MDE_Drift_Inventory(7d, 1h)
    | extend DriftTime = TimeGenerated, DriftBin = bin(TimeGenerated, 5min);
let audits = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

drift

| extend DeltaSec = iff(isnull(AuditTime), int(null), abs(datetime_diff('second', AuditTime, DriftTime)))
| summarize arg_min(DeltaSec, OperationName, InitiatedByUpn, AuditTime) by DriftTime, StreamName, EntityId, FieldName, OldValue, NewValue, ChangeType
| project TimeGenerated = DriftTime, StreamName, EntityId, FieldName, OldValue, NewValue, ChangeType, OperationName, InitiatedByUpn
| order by TimeGenerated desc","size":0,"title":"Recent changes with attribution","queryType":0,"visualization":"table"},"name":"recent-changes-table"}],"fallbackResourceIds":[],"fromTemplateId":"sentinel-MDEComplianceDashboard","$schema":"https://github.com/Microsoft/Application-Insights-Workbooks/blob/master/schema/workbook.json"}

{"$schema":"https://github.com/Microsoft/Application-Insights-Workbooks/blob/master/schema/workbook.json","fallbackResourceIds":[],"fromTemplateId":"sentinel-MDE_DriftReport","items":[{"name":"header","content":{"json":"# MDE Drift Report

**What this dashboard shows:** Unified configuration / inventory / exposure / maintenance drift — every change to Defender XDR tenant configuration, attributed to admin UPNs via AuditLogs cross-reference. The single pane of glass for 'what changed and who changed it' across all 4 cadence tiers.

**Use cases:**
- **Daily SOC review**: top changes overnight + after-hours drift
- **Change-management audit**: validate every drift event against approved change tickets
- **Compliance evidence**: SOC2 / ISO27001 / CMMC audit trail of configuration changes
- **Incident retrospective**: timeline of admin actions during attack dwell window
- **Admin governance**: identify role-creep, sustained config-creep, after-hours admin activity

**Data sources:** All 4 drift parsers (MDE_Drift_Configuration / MDE_Drift_Inventory / MDE_Drift_Exposure / MDE_Drift_Maintenance) + AuditLogs join on 5-minute time bins.

**Triage tip:** Filter `where ChangeType in ('Added','Modified')` for high-impact changes; 'Removed' is often legitimate cleanup."},"type":1},{"name":"parameters","content":{"parameters":[{"value":{"durationMs":604800000},"id":"tr","name":"TimeRange","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","type":4,"typeSettings":{"selectableValues":[{"durationMs":3600000},{"durationMs":86400000},{"durationMs":604800000},{"durationMs":2592000000}]}}],"queryType":0,"style":"pills","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0"},"type":9},{"name":"panel-1","content":{"queryType":0,"title":"Drift events over time, by category","size":0,"query":"// Section R++.C B8 fix (2026-05-07): window arg must match tier cadence.
// Inventory cadence=1d, Configuration cadence=6h. Original 1h/30m windows missed 23/24+ of poll cycles.
union
  (MDE_Drift_Inventory(7d, 1d) | extend Category = "Endpoint Config"),
  (MDE_Drift_Configuration(7d, 6h) | extend Category = "Detection Pipeline"),
  (MDE_Drift_Configuration(7d, 6h) | extend Category = "Governance"),
  (MDE_Drift_Inventory(7d, 1d) | extend Category = "Identity"),
  (MDE_Drift_Configuration(7d, 6h) | extend Category = "Metadata")
| summarize Changes = count() by Category, bin(TimeGenerated, 6h)
| render timechart","version":"KqlItem/1.0"},"type":3},{"name":"panel-2","content":{"queryType":0,"title":"Recent drift events (all categories)","size":0,"query":"// Section R++.C B8 fix (2026-05-07): window aligned to tier cadence.
union
  (MDE_Drift_Inventory(7d, 1d)),
  (MDE_Drift_Configuration(7d, 6h))
| project TimeGenerated, StreamName, EntityId, FieldName, OldValue, NewValue, ChangeType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100","version":"KqlItem/1.0"},"type":3}],"version":"Notebook/1.0"}

{"$schema":"https://github.com/Microsoft/Application-Insights-Workbooks/blob/master/schema/workbook.json","fallbackResourceIds":[],"fromTemplateId":"sentinel-MDE_ExposureMap","items":[{"name":"header","content":{"json":"# MDE Exposure Map

**What this dashboard shows:** Microsoft Security Exposure Management (XSPM) intelligence — simulated attack paths from internet/email entry points to crown-jewel assets, network chokepoints (high-leverage hardening targets), and tenant exposure score trending over time.

**Use cases:**
- **CISO executive reporting**: monthly tenant exposure score trend + top remediation opportunities
- **Hardening prioritization**: identify chokepoints that break MANY attack paths simultaneously
- **Asset criticality review**: validate which assets are tagged Critical + verify XSPM treats them correctly
- **Path-break validation**: simulate hardening actions before applying them; confirm path elimination

**License:** Requires Microsoft Security Exposure Management (XSPM) — E5 + Security add-on. Empty data on unlicensed tenants.

**Data sources:** `Defender_ExposureManagement_CL` (XSPM streams: AttackPaths, ChokePoints, TopTargets, etc.) — hourly cadence XspmGraph tier."},"type":1},{"name":"parameters","content":{"parameters":[{"value":{"durationMs":604800000},"id":"tr","name":"TimeRange","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","type":4,"typeSettings":{"selectableValues":[{"durationMs":3600000},{"durationMs":86400000},{"durationMs":604800000},{"durationMs":2592000000}]}}],"queryType":0,"style":"pills","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0"},"type":9},{"name":"panel-1","content":{"queryType":0,"title":"Active attack paths","size":0,"query":"Defender_ExposureManagement_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_XspmAttackPaths_CL'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EntityId
| project PathId, Source, Target, HopCount, Severity, Status, CreatedTime, TimeGenerated
| order by Severity asc, HopCount asc","version":"KqlItem/1.0"},"type":3},{"name":"panel-2","content":{"queryType":0,"title":"Exposure score trend","size":0,"query":"Defender_ExposureManagement_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_ExposureSnapshots_CL'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize AvgScore = avg(Score) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| render timechart","version":"KqlItem/1.0"},"type":3}],"version":"Notebook/1.0"}

{"$schema":"https://github.com/Microsoft/Application-Insights-Workbooks/blob/master/schema/workbook.json","fallbackResourceIds":[],"fromTemplateId":"sentinel-MDE_GovernanceScorecard","items":[{"name":"header","content":{"json":"# MDE Governance Scorecard

**What this dashboard shows:** Defender XDR governance posture — Unified RBAC role assignments, RBAC device groups, asset criticality classifications, asset rules, and admin approval workflows. Visualizes 'who can do what to whom' across the tenant.

**Use cases:**
- **Quarterly access review**: who has Defender admin permissions; who SHOULD?
- **Role-creep detection**: trending of role additions over 90d/180d windows
- **Asset classification audit**: which devices are tagged Critical; verify correctness
- **Approval workflow validation**: pending approvals + admin-attested device groups
- **Compliance evidence**: SOC2 / ISO27001 access-control evidence pack

**Data sources:** `MDE_UnifiedRbacRoles_CL`, `MDE_RbacDeviceGroups_CL`, `MDE_AssetRules_CL`, `MDE_AssetClassificationSchema_CL` — Configuration + Inventory tiers.

**Pair with:** `RbacEscalationEvents.yaml` hunting query for time-series role-addition tracking."},"type":1},{"name":"parameters","content":{"parameters":[{"value":{"durationMs":604800000},"id":"tr","name":"TimeRange","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","type":4,"typeSettings":{"selectableValues":[{"durationMs":3600000},{"durationMs":86400000},{"durationMs":604800000},{"durationMs":2592000000}]}}],"queryType":0,"style":"pills","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0"},"type":9},{"name":"panel-1","content":{"queryType":0,"title":"RBAC device groups (current state)","size":0,"query":"Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_RbacDeviceGroups_CL'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EntityId
| project Name, GroupId, Description, Priority, AutoRemediationLevel, MachineCount, RuleCount, IsUnassigned, LastUpdated, TimeGenerated","version":"KqlItem/1.0"},"type":3},{"name":"panel-2","content":{"queryType":0,"title":"Governance drift","size":0,"query":"MDE_Drift_Configuration(7d, 1d)
| summarize Changes = count() by StreamName
| render piechart","version":"KqlItem/1.0"},"type":3}],"version":"Notebook/1.0"}

{"$schema":"https://github.com/Microsoft/Application-Insights-Workbooks/blob/master/schema/workbook.json","fallbackResourceIds":[],"fromTemplateId":"sentinel-MDE_IdentityPosture","items":[{"name":"header","content":{"json":"# MDE Identity Posture

**What this dashboard shows:** Microsoft Defender for Identity (MDI) deployment posture — domain controller sensor coverage, service account inventory + classification, identity onboarding state, and alert-threshold drift tracking.

**Use cases:**
- **MDI deployment validation**: every DC has an active sensor (`IsActive=True`)
- **Service account inventory**: track classified service accounts + their privilege levels
- **Sensor health monitoring**: detect DC sensor offline events (silent identity-detection blind spots)
- **Threshold drift**: alert thresholds being weakened over time = detection blind-spot accumulation
- **MDI onboarding gaps**: identify DCs not yet sensored (incomplete coverage)

**License:** Requires Microsoft Defender for Identity. Empty data on unlicensed tenants.

**Data sources:** `MDE_DCCoverage_CL`, `MDE_IdentityServiceAccounts_CL`, `MDE_IdentityOnboarding_CL`, `MDE_IdentityAlertThresholds_CL`, `MDE_RemediationAccounts_CL` — Inventory tier.

**Pair with:** `MdiDcSensorDown.yaml` analytic rule + `MdiServiceAccountDrift.yaml` hunting query."},"type":1},{"name":"parameters","content":{"parameters":[{"value":{"durationMs":604800000},"id":"tr","name":"TimeRange","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","type":4,"typeSettings":{"selectableValues":[{"durationMs":3600000},{"durationMs":86400000},{"durationMs":604800000},{"durationMs":2592000000}]}}],"queryType":0,"style":"pills","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0"},"type":9},{"name":"panel-1","content":{"queryType":0,"title":"Domain controller sensor coverage","size":0,"query":"Defender_IdentityProtection_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_DCCoverage_CL'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EntityId
| summarize Coverage = countif(IsActive == true), Total = count()
| extend CoveragePct = todouble(Coverage) / todouble(Total) * 100","version":"KqlItem/1.0"},"type":3},{"name":"panel-2","content":{"queryType":0,"title":"Identity drift over time","size":0,"query":"MDE_Drift_Inventory(7d, 1d)
| summarize Changes = count() by StreamName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| render timechart","version":"KqlItem/1.0"},"type":3}],"version":"Notebook/1.0"}

{"$schema":"https://github.com/Microsoft/Application-Insights-Workbooks/blob/master/schema/workbook.json","fallbackResourceIds":[],"fromTemplateId":"sentinel-MDE_ResponseAudit","items":[{"name":"header","content":{"json":"# MDE Response Audit

**What this dashboard shows:** Historical Action Center activity — every response action taken, by which operator, with what justification comment, and how quickly it was acted on. Time-to-action metrics surface SOC operational efficiency + SLA compliance.

**Use cases:**
- **SOC manager**: weekly responder-activity report; identify top performers + SLA gaps
- **Compliance audit**: evidence of timely incident response (SOC2, ISO27001)
- **IR retrospective**: detailed action timeline for post-incident reviews
- **Operator coaching**: identify training opportunities (e.g., responders who skip justification comments)

**Data sources:** `Defender_ActionCenter_CL` (MDE_ActionCenter_CL — covers all machine actions: Isolate/UnIsolate/AntivirusScan/CollectInvestigationPackage/LR/AIR via canonical /actionCenter/actioncenterui/history-actions endpoint) — historical 30-90d analysis recommended."},"type":1},{"name":"parameters","content":{"parameters":[{"value":{"durationMs":604800000},"id":"tr","name":"TimeRange","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","type":4,"typeSettings":{"selectableValues":[{"durationMs":3600000},{"durationMs":86400000},{"durationMs":604800000},{"durationMs":2592000000}]}}],"queryType":0,"style":"pills","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0"},"type":9},{"name":"panel-1","content":{"queryType":0,"title":"Action Center summary by type and status","size":0,"query":"Defender_ActionCenter_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_ActionCenter_CL'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by ActionType, ActionStatus
| render barchart","version":"KqlItem/1.0"},"type":3},{"name":"panel-2","content":{"queryType":0,"title":"Time-to-action by action type","size":0,"query":"Defender_ActionCenter_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_ActionCenter_CL'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotnull(StartTime) and isnotnull(EndTime)
| extend TimeToActionMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', EndTime, StartTime)
| project TimeGenerated, ActionId, ActionType, ActionStatus, ActionDecision, Operator, MachineId, ComputerName, TimeToActionMinutes
| order by TimeGenerated desc","version":"KqlItem/1.0"},"type":3}],"version":"Notebook/1.0"}

{"version":"Notebook/1.0","items":[{"type":1,"content":{"json":"# XdrLogRaider — Connector Health

**What this dashboard shows:** Operator-facing observability for the XdrLogRaider connector — auth chain status, ingestion rates, DLQ backpressure, per-tier freshness, per-stream last-row markers, and service account sign-in baseline.

**Use cases:**
- **Daily SOC stand-up**: connector card status; any tier stale; auth health green
- **On-call runbook**: 5-min triage when connector card flips Disconnected
- **Capacity planning**: ingestion volume trends per stream + tier
- **Cost monitoring**: row-volume baseline + spike detection
- **Service account governance**: sign-in anomaly review

**Panels:**
1. Per-tier last-fresh poll markers (5 capability tiers + heartbeat)
2. Auth chain failures last 24h (AppExceptions filtered to AuthChain.*)
3. DLQ depth and oldest-entry age
4. Freshness SLI per consolidated category
5. Per-row partial-success rate per stream
6. Service account sign-in anomaly summary (uses $(SERVICE_ACCOUNT_UPN) deployment parameter)
7. Per-stream freshness (workspace-side last row per SourceName across 10 category tables)

**Data sources:** `XdrConnectorHealth_CL` + `AppExceptions` + `AppMetrics` + all 10 `Defender_<Category>_CL` workspace tables.

For triage workflows see [docs/RUNBOOK.md](https://github.com/akefallonitis/xdrlograider/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md)."},"name":"title"},{"type":9,"content":{"version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","parameters":[{"id":"0aa11111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","name":"TimeRange","label":"Time range","type":4,"isRequired":true,"value":{"durationMs":86400000},"typeSettings":{"selectableValues":[{"durationMs":3600000},{"durationMs":14400000},{"durationMs":86400000},{"durationMs":604800000}]}},{"id":"0bb22222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222","version":"KqlParameterItem/1.0","name":"Portal","label":"Portal","type":2,"isRequired":true,"value":"Defender","typeSettings":{"additionalResourceOptions":[],"showDefault":false},"jsonData":"[{"value":"Defender","label":"Defender"}]"}],"style":"above","queryType":0},"name":"params"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"XdrConnectorHealth_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(Tier)
| summarize LastSeenUtc = max(TimeGenerated), HeartbeatCount = count(), TotalRowsIngested = sum(RowsIngested) by Tier
| extend StaleMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastSeenUtc)
| extend Status = case(
    Tier == 'Heartbeat'      and StaleMinutes <= 10,    'Healthy',
    Tier == 'ActionCenter'   and StaleMinutes <= 20,    'Healthy',
    Tier == 'XspmGraph'      and StaleMinutes <= 120,   'Healthy',
    Tier == 'Configuration'  and StaleMinutes <= 720,   'Healthy',
    Tier == 'Inventory'      and StaleMinutes <= 2880,  'Healthy',
    Tier == 'Maintenance'    and StaleMinutes <= 20160, 'Healthy',
    'Stale'
)
| project Tier, Status, StaleMinutes, LastSeenUtc, HeartbeatCount, TotalRowsIngested
| sort by Tier asc","size":0,"title":"Per-tier poll freshness (last vs cadence threshold)","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","visualization":"table","gridSettings":{"formatters":[{"columnMatch":"Status","formatter":18,"formatOptions":{"thresholdsOptions":"colors","thresholdsGrid":[{"operator":"==","thresholdValue":"Healthy","representation":"green","text":"{0}{1}"},{"operator":"Default","representation":"redBright","text":"{0}{1}"}]}}]}},"name":"panel-1-poll-freshness"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend ErrorClass = tostring(Properties.ErrorClass)
| where ErrorClass startswith 'AuthChain.'
| summarize FailureCount = count() by ErrorClass, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart","size":0,"title":"Auth chain failures over time (AppExceptions where ErrorClass startswith AuthChain.)","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"},"name":"panel-2-auth-chain"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// B3 (Plan R+++++++++.2): DLQ telemetry - depth from Pop-XdrIngestDlq + pending_count from Connector-Heartbeat (current backlog snapshot)
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name in ('xdr.dlq.depth', 'xdr.dlq.pop_count', 'xdr.dlq.pending_count')
| summarize MaxValue = max(Max) by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| render timechart","size":0,"title":"DLQ depth + pending_count + pop rate over time (B3)","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"},"name":"panel-3-dlq"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name == 'xdr.ingest.row_age_seconds'
| extend Stream = tostring(Properties.Stream)
| summarize p95FreshnessSeconds = percentile(Max, 95) by Stream
| sort by p95FreshnessSeconds desc","size":0,"title":"Freshness SLI per stream (p95 row age in seconds)","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"},"name":"panel-4-freshness-sli"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name == 'xdr.ingest.row_success_rate'
| extend Stream = tostring(Properties.Stream)
| summarize MinSuccessRate = min(Min), AvgSuccessRate = avg(Sum / toreal(ItemCount)) by Stream
| extend Health = case(MinSuccessRate >= 0.99, 'Healthy', MinSuccessRate >= 0.90, 'Degraded', 'Failed')
| sort by MinSuccessRate asc","size":0,"title":"Per-stream partial-success rate (min/avg in window)","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"},"name":"panel-5-partial-success"},{"type":3,"content":{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"// Operator MUST replace $(SERVICE_ACCOUNT_UPN) with their service account UPN

SigninLogs

            UniqueIPs = dcount(IPAddress),

            FailedSignIns = countif(ResultType != 0)
            by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

properties.description:
**What it detects:** A Defender XDR alert-tuning rule had `conditions` or `scope` MODIFIED — broader suppression criteria, potentially hiding legitimate alerts.

**Why this matters:** Tuning is legitimate FP reduction, but also stealth attacker tactic — broaden tuning to silence alerts before payload. Rule narrowed to "specific service account/machine" being widened to "any" is the classic indicator.

**Triage path:**
1. Identify modified rule via EntityId — what alert types are now suppressed?
2. Verify against change-management ticket
3. Cross-ref ConfigChangesByUpn for the admin actor
4. Unauthorized: revert + investigate admin session compromise
5. Hunt activity in now-suppressed categories during the broadening window

**Severity:** Medium — common but offers high attacker value (escalate to High if SilentBypassIndicators co-occur).

**MITRE:** TA0005 Defense Evasion — T1562.006 Indicator Blocking.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Configuration(12h, 1h) | where StreamName == "MDE_AlertTuning_CL" | where ChangeType == "Modified" | where FieldName in ("conditions","scope")

properties.description: Detects new third-party app registered as a Defender XDR Connected App — programmatic API access to alerts/devices/configurations/IR actions. Each is a stealable credential + privileged token. Unsanctioned apps = persistence mechanism. Severity Low baseline; Medium if Machine.ReadWrite.All or Alert.ReadWrite.All scope. MITRE: TA0003 Persistence — T1098 Account Manipulation; T1136.003 Create Cloud Account. See KQL body for triage path.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Configuration(6h, 10m) | where StreamName == "MDE_ConnectedApps_CL" | where ChangeType == "Added"

properties.description: Detects new streaming/export destination ADDED to Defender data-export settings (Event Hub, Storage account, or Log Analytics workspace). Same mechanism legitimate SOCs use is also a data-exfiltration channel — attacker adds their own destination, Defender ships raw telemetry (alerts, device events, identity events) to attacker infrastructure. Severity Medium baseline; High if destination external Azure tenant. MITRE: TA0010 Exfiltration — T1537 Transfer Data to Cloud Account (PRIMARY). See KQL body for triage path.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Maintenance(1h, 10m) | where StreamName == "MDE_DataExportSettings_CL" | where ChangeType == "Added"

properties.displayName: MDE Live Response unsigned scripts enabled
properties.description: Defender Live Response `allowUnsignedScripts` flipped to `true` tenant-wide — responders can run arbitrary unsigned PS/bash on any managed endpoint via LR sessions. Code signing is the last layer protecting LR from weaponization; sustained ON = strong "attacker establishing RCE capability" signal. Legitimate responders rarely need this (workaround: pre-sign scripts in IR library). Severity High — admin compromise + this = SYSTEM-equivalent code execution fleet-wide. MITRE: TA0005 Defense Evasion — T1562.001; TA0002 Execution — T1059. See KQL body for triage path.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Inventory(2h, 15m) | where StreamName == "MDE_LiveResponseConfig_CL" | where FieldName == "allowUnsignedScripts" and NewValue == "true"

properties.description: MDI sensor on a domain controller stopped reporting (`MDE_DCCoverage_CL.IsActive` True→False). Canonical "identity threat detection blind spot" signal. MDI sensors feed AD-side detections (kerberoasting, golden ticket, DCSync, replication abuse, LDAP recon) — inactive sensor = those detections silently disappear. Causes: DC reboot, network partition, service crash, OR attacker action (sensor disable is known tactic to mask DCSync). Severity High — every minute of blind time = potential undetected credential attack. License: requires MDI. MITRE: TA0005 — T1562; TA0006 Credential Access — T1003.006 DCSync. See KQL body for triage path.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Inventory(2d, 1d) | where StreamName == "MDE_DCCoverage_CL" | where FieldName == "IsActive" and OldValue == "True" and NewValue == "False"

properties.displayName: MDE portal config change outside business hours
properties.description: Any Defender XDR tenant-configuration or inventory drift event recorded outside 09:00-17:00 UTC business hours. Attackers prefer off-hours config changes for stealth — fewer eyes, longer notice window, alert flood diluted by next-day signals. Legitimate after-hours changes need paired ticket. Severity Low — high FP volume in 24x7 SOC tenants; primarily context anchor for IR retrospective. Tuning: adjust 9/17 to local business hours; 24x7 ops disable or widen to weekends-only. MITRE: TA0005 Defense Evasion — T1562. See KQL body for triage path.
properties.query: union (MDE_Drift_Configuration(2h, 15m)), (MDE_Drift_Inventory(2h, 15m)) | extend HourOfDay = datetime_part("Hour", TimeGenerated) | where HourOfDay < 9 or HourOfDay >= 17

properties.description: Defender PUA (Potentially Unwanted Application) protection disabled tenant-wide (`MDE_PUAConfig_CL.enabled` flipped to `false`). PUA blocks dual-use tools (PsExec, BloodHound, certutil, mimikatz variants) attackers use for lateral movement, credential dumping, recon. Tenant-wide disable = those tools execute silently — strong "attacker preparing hands-on-keyboard activity" signal. Severity High — disabling tier-2 EDR defense rarely benign. MITRE: TA0005 Defense Evasion — T1562.001 (PRIMARY). See KQL body for triage path.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Inventory(2h, 15m) | where StreamName == "MDE_PUAConfig_CL" | where FieldName == "enabled" and NewValue == "false"

properties.displayName: MDE RBAC role to unusual account
properties.description: New principalId/principalName added to Defender XDR Unified RBAC roles — account gained Defender permissions it didn't have. RBAC additions = canonical privilege-escalation signal. Attacker with admin compromise grants themselves or backdoor account Defender admin perms to maintain SOC-tooling control across password rotations. Severity High — RBAC additions infrequent in stable envs; every one needs justification. MITRE: TA0004 Privilege Escalation — T1078 (PRIMARY); TA0003 Persistence — T1098, T1136. See KQL body for triage path.
properties.query:
MDE_Drift_Configuration(7d, 1d)
| where StreamName == "MDE_UnifiedRbacRoles_CL"
| where ChangeType == "Added"
| where FieldName == "principalId" or FieldName == "principalName"

properties.description:
**What it detects:** New Event Hub or Storage target configured for Defender telemetry streaming. Semantic alias for `DataExportNewDestination` — same signal, kept under "streaming API" name for operators searching by Microsoft's legacy nomenclature.

**Why this matters:** Same data-exfiltration risk as DataExportNewDestination — see that rule for full triage path.

**Triage path:**
1. See DataExportNewDestination.yaml triage path — identical
2. Coordinate alerts: if both rules fire on same drift, treat as one incident not two

**Severity:** Medium baseline; High if destination external Azure tenant.

**REDIRECTED 2026-05-06:** legacy `MDE_StreamingApiConfig_CL` is `Availability='deprecated'` (404 on modern tenants). Canonical surface = `MDE_DataExportSettings_CL` (Maintenance tier). Rule kept as semantic alias.

**MITRE:** TA0010 Exfiltration — T1537 Transfer Data to Cloud Account (PRIMARY).
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Maintenance(1h, 10m) | where StreamName == "MDE_DataExportSettings_CL" | where ChangeType == "Added"

properties.description: Defender alert-suppression rule had `scope`, `conditions`, or `machineGroup` MODIFIED — narrow→broad widening. Suppression rules legitimately silence noisy alerts (test machines, vendor scanners, FPs); narrow-to-broad widening is the textbook attacker move (silence alerts the upcoming payload will trigger across broader scope). One of the highest-value attacker preparation signals. Severity Medium — legitimate scope adjustments occur but every widening needs ticket. MITRE: TA0005 Defense Evasion — T1562.006 Indicator Blocking (PRIMARY). See KQL body for triage path.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Configuration(2h, 15m) | where StreamName == "MDE_SuppressionRules_CL" | where ChangeType == "Modified" | where FieldName in ("scope","conditions","machineGroup")

properties.description: Defender Tamper Protection disabled (`AdvancedFeatures.tamperProtection.Enabled` flipped to `false`). When ON, Tamper Protection prevents users (including admins via PowerShell/GPO) from disabling Defender, removing definitions, or modifying exclusions. Disabling = "anti-attacker" defense weakened; rarely justified outside narrow troubleshooting windows. Sustained `Enabled=false` = one of strongest "attacker prepared the ground" signals. Severity High — EDR's last-line defense; disabling rarely benign. MITRE: TA0005 Defense Evasion — T1562.001 (PRIMARY); T1562.012 cross-platform. See KQL body for triage path.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Inventory(48h, 4h) | where StreamName == "MDE_AdvancedFeatures_CL" | where EntityId has "Tamper" | where FieldName == "Enabled" and NewValue == "false"

properties.description: New entry (URL, domain, IP, file hash, sender) ADDED to Defender Tenant Allow/Block List (TABL) — bypasses normal threat-blocking. Most direct "let this past your defenses" mechanism. Attacker adds C2 domain → every network call bypasses URL filtering; adds file hash → file runs without scan. Even legitimate exclusions need scrutiny — vendor "false positive" claim doesn't justify without ticket + risk acceptance. Severity Medium baseline; High if known-malicious rep OR bypasses active block last 7d. MITRE: TA0005 Defense Evasion — T1562; TA0011 C2 — T1071 (when allow-listed = C2). See KQL body for triage path.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Configuration(2h, 15m) | where StreamName == "MDE_TenantAllowBlock_CL" | where ChangeType == "Added"

properties.displayName: [XdrOps] Connector auth chain failure - elevated AADSTS exception rate
properties.description: XdrLogRaider's portal auth chain (TOTP → passkey → ESTSAUTH → sccauth → XSRF-TOKEN) producing `AuthChain.*` exceptions at elevated rate (>3 in 1h window). Auth failure = NO data flows from 65 streams; connector card flips Disconnected, telemetry pipeline goes dark. Causes: SA credential rotation needed, TOTP seed clock drift, Entra CA policy block, portal contract change, or Microsoft auth-service incident. Severity High — connector outage = SOC visibility loss. MITRE: TA0001 Initial Access — T1078 Valid Accounts. See KQL body + docs/RUNBOOK.md "Auth chain failure" section for triage.
properties.query:
// Filter to XdrLogRaider Function App App Insights, then to AuthChain.* exception classes.
// Threshold: >3 AuthChain.* exceptions in 1h window (more than transient ESTS flake).
AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated > ago(4h)
| extend ErrorClass = tostring(Properties.ErrorClass)
| where ErrorClass startswith "AuthChain."
| summarize FailureCount = count(), Stages = make_set(ErrorClass) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where FailureCount > 3
| project TimeGenerated, FailureCount, Stages

properties.displayName: [XdrOps] Connector auth chain staleness - silent hang detection
properties.description: XdrLogRaider's auth chain stopped emitting `AuthChain.Completed` events for >30min — SILENT hang in auth flow. Complement to XdrOps-AuthChainFailure (which catches NOISY failures); this catches SILENT death where auth stops mid-flow without exception. Heartbeat may still fire while data polls are dead. Causes: Microsoft auth throttling without 429, HTTP timeout on portal selfTest, FA host hung, PowerShell module load deadlock. Severity High — silent connector death = SOC visibility loss without explicit alerting. MITRE: TA0001 Initial Access — T1078. See KQL body + docs/RUNBOOK.md "Auth chain hang" section for triage.

properties.displayName: [XdrOps] Connector tier stale - no ingest beyond expected cadence
properties.description: XdrLogRaider tier has not written `XdrConnectorHealth_CL` rows for >2x expected cadence — entire dispatch chain (Xdr-Refresh → orchestrator → activity → heartbeat) has stopped for that tier. Each tier (ActionCenter/XspmGraph/Configuration/Inventory/Maintenance/Heartbeat) = logical group of streams polled together; tier silent = ALL streams dark. Thresholds (2x cadence): ActionCenter >20m | XspmGraph >2h | Configuration >12h | Inventory >2d | Maintenance >2w | Heartbeat >10m. Severity Medium — cadence-specific data loss; High if multiple tiers stale. MITRE: TA0005 Defense Evasion — T1562. See KQL body + docs/RUNBOOK.md "Tier stale" for triage.
properties.query:
let cadenceLimits = datatable(Tier: string, MaxStaleMin: long)
[
"ActionCenter",   20,
"XspmGraph",      120,
"Configuration",  720,
"Inventory",      2880,
"Maintenance",    20160,
"Heartbeat",      10
];
XdrConnectorHealth_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where isnotempty(Tier)
| summarize LastSeenUtc = max(TimeGenerated) by Tier
| join kind=inner cadenceLimits on Tier
| extend StaleMin = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastSeenUtc)
| where StaleMin > MaxStaleMin
| project Tier, LastSeenUtc, StaleMin, MaxStaleMin

properties.displayName: [XdrOps] Connector DLQ depth or age exceeds operator threshold
properties.description: XdrLogRaider's ingest DLQ (Storage Table `xdrIngestDlq`) has Depth >100 entries (sustained backpressure) OR oldest entry >2h (replay isn't keeping up). DLQ = connector safety net for DCE ingestion failures (5xx, 429, network). Healthy: DLQ near-empty as `Pop-XdrIngestDlq` drains every poll cycle. Sustained depth/age = DCE sustained issues, batches too large for retry, auth blocking replay, or DLQ regression. Auto-drain runs every Xdr-PollStream with TTL eviction. Severity Medium — backpressure = degraded ingest, not data loss (DLQ preserves). MITRE: TA0005 Defense Evasion — T1562. See KQL body + docs/RUNBOOK.md "DLQ backlog" for triage.

ANY stream's hourly row count exceeds 3× its 7-day rolling baseline. Cost-budget gate (Sentinel ingestion per-GB; runaway connector can blow monthly budget in days) + quality signal. 3x volume means: operator schema explosion (wildcard PathParams fan out), tenant breach (mass policy push by attacker), connector regression (broken dedup), ProjectionMap mis-config (property-bag flatten N-fold multiplication), or legitimate fleet onboarding (4h suppression handles). Severity Medium — cost impact gradual; investigate within 24h. MITRE: TA0040 Impact — T1565 Data Manipulation. See KQL body + docs/RUNBOOK.md "Row-volume spike" for triage.

XdrLogRaider service account (UPN from `SERVICE_ACCOUNT_UPN` ARM parameter) signed in from anomalous country/IP, OR targeted by credential stuffing (failed-then-success), OR bypassed MFA. SA = XdrLogRaider's security boundary; compromised SA enables attacker to silently mirror security telemetry, understand detection gaps, plan attacks tuned to bypass your Defender config. Severity High — SA compromise = silent SOC-telemetry exfiltration vector. Config: UPN bound at ARM deploy via SERVICE_ACCOUNT_UPN. 14-day baseline = Sentinel queryPeriod max (P14D). MITRE: TA0001 Initial Access — T1078; TA0006 Credential Access — T1110 Brute Force. See KQL body + docs/RUNBOOK.md SA rotation runbook for triage.

properties.displayName: MDE XSPM new attack path discovered
properties.description: Defender XSPM identified a NEW attack path in last 7d — route from internet/email/identity entry through chain of hops. Every new path = SOMETHING changed that opened new attacker progression (group memberships, new vulnerable software, firewall rules opening lateral movement, identity perms enabling impersonation). Without tracking deltas, you miss gradual posture erosion. Severity Medium — escalate via XspmPathToCriticalAsset if destination Critical. License: requires XSPM (E5 + Security add-on); dormant on unlicensed tenants. MITRE: TA0043 Reconnaissance — T1595 Active Scanning. See KQL body for triage path.
properties.query: MDE_Drift_Exposure(7d, 1h) | where StreamName == "MDE_XspmAttackPaths_CL" | where ChangeType == "Added"

properties.displayName: MDE XSPM path to critical asset
properties.description: XSPM attack-path simulation identified a route ending at a device tagged `Critical`. Defender continuously simulates attacker progressions; this fires when ANY path now terminates at a crown-jewel asset. Path ending at Critical means attack is feasible TODAY, attacker doesn't need privileged access to start, asset reachable through some chain of compromises. Severity High — paths to Critical assets = top-priority hardening candidates. License: requires XSPM (E5 + Security add-on); dormant on unlicensed tenants. MITRE: TA0043 Reconnaissance — T1595; TA0008 Lateral Movement — T1570. See KQL body for triage path.
properties.query: Defender_ExposureManagement_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_XspmAttackPaths_CL' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EntityId | extend TargetCriticality = tostring(parse_json(RawJson).targetCriticality) | where TargetCriticality == "Critical" | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
